title: Add `sm_107` for Rubin support
body:
The [CUDA 13.4](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/developer-preview/13.4/cuda-toolkit-release-notes/index.html) adds support for the NVIDIA Rubin Architecture (compute capability 10.7).

This PR add some `sm_107` to various places, so PyTorch is Rubin aware.

**Important**: we do not need to specifically compile with `sm_107` arch flag for the releases, since `sm_107` instructions are compatible with `sm_100` (just like `sm_103`).
